grandline.base.refuse.disabled: Crew bases are turned off on this server.
grandline.base.refuse.no_character: Create your character before you plant a flag.
grandline.base.refuse.wrong_world: A crew flag can only be planted on an island of the open sea (not in the sky, the deep sea or elsewhere).
grandline.base.refuse.not_island: Plant the flag on dry land at the heart of an island.
grandline.base.refuse.canon: %s is a known island with its own people and history: it cannot be claimed.
grandline.base.refuse.settled: People live on %s: only an uninhabited island can be claimed.
grandline.base.refuse.limit: Your crew already holds as many islands as it may (%s). Abandon one first (/base abandon).
grandline.base.refuse.not_heart: That is the shore of %s: carry the flag inland, to the heart of the island.
grandline.base.refuse.story: Too close to one of the island's story places (%s blocks): those stay open to every traveller. Move the flag away.
grandline.base.refuse.threat: Clear the island's heart first: %s hostile(s) nearby.
grandline.base.claimed: Your crew's flag flies over %s! Use the flag (or /base) for the base menu.
grandline.base.no_dock: No open water near the flag for a dock: stand in the sea near the base and use /base dock.
grandline.base.removed.abandoned: ⚑ %s struck their flag on %s: the island is free again.
grandline.base.removed.struck: ⚑ The flag of %s on %s was taken down.
grandline.base.removed.captured: ⚑ %s have lost %s: their flag was captured and is gone.
grandline.base.transfer_same: That player has no character or already sails in this crew.
grandline.base.not_leader: Only the base's founder or the crew's captain can do that.
grandline.base.dock_set: The base dock is now at %s, %s: crew ships moored there are repaired for free.
grandline.base.dock_refused: Stand at the water's edge or in the sea within %s blocks of the flag to set the dock.
grandline.base.flag_hint: The flag stands while the base does: use /base abandon to strike it.
grandline.base.protected: This is the base of %s: only their crew can build here.
grandline.base.chest_outside: A base chest only works inside a crew's base.
grandline.base.none: Your crew holds no island. Plant a crew flag at the heart of an uninhabited island to claim one.
grandline.base.abandon_confirm: Strike your flag on %s? The warehouse spills at the flag and the hands leave.
grandline.base.menu.title: ⚑ %s — base on %s
grandline.base.menu.set_dock.desc: Moor the base's ships where you stand (in the sea near the base)
grandline.base.menu.raid_0: a raid ship is coming in!
grandline.base.menu.raid_2: THE FLAG IS TAKEN: retake it!
grandline.base.menu.abandon.desc: Strike the flag and give up the island
grandline.base.upgrade.watchtower.desc: Early warning: raid ships are sighted far out and every crew member online is warned; raiders glow.
grandline.base.upgrade.dojo.desc: Style and Haki mastery training inside the base counts half again.
grandline.base.upgrade.galley.desc: Dishes cooked inside the base come out a quality step better; a hot meal for the crew every minute.
grandline.base.upgrade.medbay.desc: Crew inside the base heal a heart every 2 seconds.
grandline.base.upgrade.slip.desc: Ship upgrades for your ships at the base dock, a quarter off the shipwright's price.
grandline.base.upgrade.quarters.desc: Room for four hired hands who live at the base and defend it.
grandline.base.upgrade_short: You are %s %s short (your pack and the warehouse count).
grandline.base.slip_none: The base has no shipyard slip for that (the coating is only done at Sabaody).
grandline.base.slip_no_ship: Moor your ship at the base dock first.
grandline.base.slip_done: The slip fitted %s to %s for %s Beli.
grandline.base.hire_no_quarters: Build crew quarters before you hire hands.
grandline.base.raid.watchtower: ⚑ Watchtower: %s is bearing down on your base on %s (%s blocks out)!
grandline.base.raid.landed: ⚑ Raiders from %s have landed on %s (%s of them): defend the flag!
grandline.base.raid.at_flag: ⚑ Raiders are at your flag on %s and nobody defends it: it falls in %s seconds!
grandline.base.raid.flag_taken: ⚑ Pirates have taken the flag of %s on %s! Retake it within %s seconds or the island is lost.
grandline.base.raid.flag_taken_marines: ⚑ The Marines have taken the flag of %s on %s! Retake it within %s seconds or the island is lost.
grandline.base.raid.repelled_paid: ⚑ The raid on %s is repelled! Your share for the fight: %s Beli.
grandline.base.raid.plundered: ⚑ The raiders row away from %s with %s stack(s) from the warehouse.
grandline.base.raid.sunk: ⚑ The raid ship %s went down before she reached the base!
